justification: Lifecycle states drive access changes per identity profile (pre-hire/active/leave/terminated/archived); vendor docs: "Lifecycle states describe a user's status in the organization, which you can use to drive access changes for your users."
Certification campaigns review entitlement, access-profile and role data with revocation through connectors; vendor docs: "Certifications may include entitlement, access profile, and role data."

First-party SoD service builds conflicting-access policy lists and surfaces violations across governance data; vendor docs: "Create Separation of Duties policies to build lists of conflicting access."
Roles obtained via access request can be approved or revoked and the role model governs assignment; vendor docs: "Roles obtained through an access request can be approved or revoked."

Automates the complete identity lifecycle from onboarding access assignment to departure revocation; vendor copy: "Automate the complete identity lifecycle, from rapidly assigning access during onboarding to automatically revoking it upon departure." (marketing-grade source — docs portal not server-renderable; capability presence per vendor, not an efficacy benchmark)

AI-assisted certification campaigns covering accounts, entitlements and enterprise/app roles; vendor copy on the IGA product page. (marketing-grade source — capability presence per vendor, not an efficacy benchmark)

First-party preventive and detective SoD across the application ecosystem; vendor copy: "Detect, prevent, and remediate segregation-of-duties (SoD) conflicts across your entire application ecosystem." (marketing-grade source — capability presence per vendor, not an efficacy benchmark)

Self-service access-request management with SoD evaluated at the point of request; vendor copy: "Block conflicting access at the point of request with intelligent workflows." (marketing-grade source — capability presence per vendor, not an efficacy benchmark)

Lifecycle Workflows automate Joiner/Mover/Leaver tasks across the three lifecycle phases; vendor docs describe LCW J/M/L automation. Licensing caveat: requires Entra ID Governance (premium), not base Entra ID.

Access reviews recur (weekly/monthly/quarterly/annually) over groups, apps and role assignments; vendor docs: access can be "reviewed regularly to make sure only the right people have continued access."

SoD exists only as access-package incompatibility (block a request based on existing group/package membership), not a general cross-app toxic-combination engine; vendor docs constrain it to Entra access packages and groups. Will not satisfy fine-grained cross-application / ERP-grade SoX/ERP SoD without a dedicated AAG/GRC capability.
Entitlement management automates access-request workflows, assignments, reviews and expiration via access packages; vendor docs describe access-request workflow automation at scale.

Built on Lifecycle Management plus Workflows; auto-provisions new hires to birthright apps and automates lifecycle tasks; vendor docs: "Automatically provision new employees to birthright apps based on their user profile attributes."

Access certifications confirm users still need access, enriched with usage context; vendor docs: "Make access certification more meaningful with the contextual information, such as sign-in frequency..."

First-party SoD exists (so not pure ADD-ON) but vendor docs constrain it to entitlement combinations on apps with the Governance Engine enabled, enforced through Access Requests / Certifications rather than a standalone cross-app engine; realistic enterprise verdict trends toward ADD-ON where ERP-grade fine-grained SoD is in scope. Quote uses an en-dash: "a two-pronged approach to manage conflicting entitlement assignments – preventative and remediative."

Self-service access requests evaluate who receives access and approval flows protect sensitive resources; vendor docs: "Okta Identity Governance uses automated, self-service requests to evaluate who receives access to resources."
